verdict.rationale: Undermind's official MCP server exposes much of the core UI workflow programmatically: deep literature reviews, full-text PDF Q&A, Markdown notes and reports, curating folders, and starring papers. The enterprise page also advertises 'Programmatic queries via API'. However, nothing documents UI/API parity, the new-paper notification feature has no evidenced programmatic equivalent, and no public API spec exists (OpenAPI probes all returned 404), so parity cannot be verified. Missing for 10: documented parity statement or public REST/OpenAPI reference, programmatic access to alerts/notifications, workspace/account management via API, and independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
